key_idea: Pick the first card of the two-digit number, then see how many different sums the other cards make.
steps: If the two-digit number starts with 1, the other two cards come from 2, 3, 4. The sums are 15, 16 and 17.
Starting with 2 gives 24, 25 and 27. Starting with 3 gives 33, 35 and 36.
No sum repeats, so there are 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12 different sums.

choice_feedback.A: There are 3 different sums for each of the 4 starting cards.
choice_feedback.B: There are 3 different sums for each of the 4 starting cards.
choice_feedback.C: There are 3 different sums for each of the 4 starting cards, and none repeat.
choice_feedback.E: Some ways to place the cards give the same sum, like 12 + 3 and 13 + 2. Count each sum once.
